audit.why: Vel'Koz is a pure-range poke mage with no early kill pressure; levels 1-2 favor Renata's Handshake all-in, but from level 3 his Q (Plasma Fission) and E (Tectonic Disruption, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD) out-range her whole kit until items and grouped fights let R flip him.
Renata's spikes are level 1-2 (before his poke pattern is online) and 2+ items (grouped R flip); Vel'Koz spikes from level 3 onward and again hard at first item once Liandry's/Luden's is online.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side disagreed with content win[] on every one of the 7 rows: rows 0-1 were tagged 'Vel'Koz' while win[] and their own why text both favor Renata, and rows 2-5 were left as the placeholder 'Skill' while win[] already names Vel'Koz.
audit.why: phases[N].side must agree with content win[N] for the same row (THE CHART RULE); rows 0-1's why text already argued for Renata (Handshake threat, root-throw) so only side needed to move, while rows 2-5's why still argued for Renata even though win[] had already flipped to Vel'Koz.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 side values to match win[], and rewrote why for rows 2-5 (the ones that actually flipped verdict) to argue for Vel'Koz using his real ability names and ranges; rows 0, 1 and 6 needed side changes only since their why text already matched the correct side.
